summary: Implemented H2 bounded tagged offer-cell handoff in src/lib.rs and rebuilt stack-candidate.so.
expected_behavior: Producers reserve and copy into preallocated slots, then either hand off directly or withdraw into the tagged global LIFO stack. Consumers preserve LIFO, capacity, ownership, and invalid-output semantics.
evidence: Seven cargo tests pass, including direct handoff, withdrawal/reuse, duplicate payloads, newest-offer LIFO, and concurrent conservation. Release build succeeded with all nine ABI exports. Evaluator MPMC correctness gate passed 100 trials. No benchmark or target allocation was run.
candidate_retention_reason: No target-bound comparable throughput row was collected; official evaluation remains deferred.
